records.name: Port Said American School
records.review_note: Current first-party Port Said Schools evidence identifies PSAS as the American section and describes Port Said Schools as a non-profit organisation. The General Association of National Institutes explains that national-institute schools are managed through educational cooperative associations and elected boards under Law 1/1990 and Ministry supervision; the MOE law index publishes that law. This is treated as independent/cooperative non-public operation, not an Egyptian state-school identity. The Cognia evidence applies to the American section and should be modeled division-scoped in D2.2.
